description: Close an issue after the fix is deployed and verified. Needs write access. For errors, prefer when=next_deploy: BugOtter then verifies the fix against real traffic and reopens it if it comes back.

when.description: Errors only. next_deploy = resolved now, then BugOtter verifies the fix against real traffic after the next deploy and reopens it if it happens after that deploy.

name: resolve_issue
title: Mark an issue resolved
